topic: Kubernetes cluster upgrade and access issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on upgrading the kubeapps system. [p1] noted that kubeapps had upgraded to version two and suggested an upgrade for their current setup. To avoid complex upgrades, [p1] decided to delete and reinstall the existing environment.

Later, when attempting to access the new kubeapps URL (http://kubeapps.allunite.local/), both participants encountered permission issues: [me] received a 'You don't have sufficient permissions to use the namespace production' error, and [p1] reported being unable to log in even with provided credentials.
decisions: [p1] will delete and reinstall the current kubeapps setup.
